dedupe_keys.name: a framework to evaluate structural fatigue accumulation and health metrics of wind farms under different operational strategies

description: Pettas, Vasilis and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The existing workflow couples operational strategies with wake-aware farm response and turbine surrogates. Explicit baseline budgets convert turbine outputs into relative fatigue and health measures, then aggregate them into farm-level indicators. Wake-steering and layout-control examples demonstrate the method. The source calls the methodology open source but does not identify an inspected implementation route here. Interchangeable model components and baseline choices affect interpretation; the indicators are model-based assessments, not direct proof of physical component condition. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The workflow is based on the combination of wake-aware response with fatigue-budget indicators.
